name: Pseudonymise bank accounts, PAN and mobile numbers, then restore them
description: Runs offline. Reads data/customers_bank.csv and replaces AccountNo, PAN and Mobile with tokens (ACC-..., PAN-..., MOB-...) in output/customers_shareable.csv, for analysts or vendors who don't need the real numbers: the same account always gets the same token, so totals and joins still work, but nobody can work out the number from the token. It is pseudonymised, not anonymous: names and amounts stay, and equal values stay recognisable as equal. The originals are kept encrypted in vault/customer_vault.db. The second half reads the shareable file back and restores the original values into output/customers_restored.csv - only possible with the vault and the key. The key is created in Windows Credential Manager on first run under key_secret; back it up with `autoflow secret show <key_secret>`.
